name: Care-circle member cannot manage the household
description: Leo (care circle) sees no owner-only controls.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Open 'Sample controls', click 'Open recipient role' and open the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link
Verify 'Maya (demo)' is shown as 'Household owner' and 'Leo (demo) (you)' as 'Care circle'
Verify no invite or remove-member control is available to Leo
Verify Settings shows 'Owner: Maya (demo)' and Leo cannot change owner-only household settings
